_README: Copy this file, rename it to annotation.<your-annotator-id>.json, replace the annotator id, and delete the two EXAMPLE controls below once you have added real ones. Validate with: npm run validate -- templates/annotation.template.json annotation. Every field marked required by the schema is present here; nothing else is permitted to be invented.

controls._EXAMPLE: A control you judge to BE a personal-name control. It carries all five rule pairs - never fewer, which would shrink the denominator, and never more, which would double-count.

stageOne.label: positive
stageOne.reason: State WHY in your own words. 'Looks like a name' is not a reason.

FF-01.label: positive
FF-01.reason: Cite the catalogue clause you applied.

FF-02.label: negative
FF-02.reason: FF-01 suppresses FF-02 where the constraint is Basic-Latin-only.

FF-04.label: negative
FF-04.reason: Apostrophe is admitted by the class.

FF-05.label: negative
FF-05.reason: Minimum accepted length is one, so FF-05 does not fire.

controls._EXAMPLE: A control you judge NOT to be a personal-name control. It carries stageOne only - no rules object at all.

stageOne.label: negative
stageOne.reason: Site search box, not a person's name.
